questions.question: What are CBA and SEA? Explain your contractual and statutory rights if your vessel is transiting or entering a High-Risk Area (HRA).
Define vicarious liability in maritime law. How do you establish vicarious liability onboard a vessel?
Explain the Montreal Protocol and its relevance to marine refrigeration and air-conditioning systems.
What is the Kigali Amendment, and how does it regulate hydrofluorocarbons (HFCs) on ships?
What is the HART protocol in marine instrumentation and control systems?
questions.answer: HART means Highway Addressable Remote Transducer. It overlays digital frequency-shift-keyed data on a conventional 4–20 mA analog instrument loop, allowing a control system or handheld communicator to read identification, diagnostics and configuration while retaining the analog process signal.

questions.question: Explain the structure of the ISM Code and enumerate all its chapters/parts.
State and explain the fundamental principles of marine insurance.
questions.answer: The core principles are insurable interest, utmost good faith and disclosure of material facts, indemnity, proximate cause, subrogation and contribution. The assured must have a legal or financial interest in the subject matter; the policy responds to a proximate insured peril and indemnifies the covered loss, while preventing double recovery.

candidate.source_excerpt:
Q36- Green Ammon!a, Grey Ammon!a, Blue ammon!a.
Ans
Ammon!a is typically produced by combining Hydr0gen and nitrogen through a method known as the Haber-Bosch
process. This so-called “brown ammonia” uses fossil fuels both to provide the Hydr0gen and the energy source.
Each tonne of ammon!a produces about 2 tonnes of greenhouse g as.
Grey Ammonia:
• Production Method: Grey ammon!a is produced using fossil fuels (usually natural g as) without any carbon
capture and storage (CCS) technologies.
• Carbon Emissions: It results in significant carbon emissions due to the use of fossil fuels.
• Common Method: Historically, most ammon!a production has followed the grey ammon!a route.
• Environmental Impact: Grey ammon!a contributes to climate change and environmental pollution.
• Market: It has been widely used in various applications, including fertilizers and industrial processes.
Blue Ammonia:
• Production Method: Blue ammon!a is essentially like conventional grey ammon!a but with an added
step: carbon capture and storage (CCS). It involves capturing the CO₂ emissions during ammon!a production.
• Carbon Emissions Reduction: By implementing CCS, blue ammon!a can reduce its carbon emissions

What are Advance Calls, Supplementary Calls, and Release Calls in a P&I Club?
questions.answer: An advance or estimated call is the member contribution budgeted for the policy year. A supplementary call is an additional contribution when the original calls do not meet claims and expenses. A release call is a final amount paid when a member leaves or closes an open policy year, releasing that member from future supplementary calls for it, subject to the club rules.

questions.answer: Utmost good faith requires both parties, particularly the assured, to disclose material facts accurately when arranging marine cover. Insurable interest means the assured has a legally recognized financial stake in the preservation of the ship, cargo or other insured subject matter and can suffer loss from the insured peril.
